title: Canvas AST
description: Geometric layer extracted from a cover image. Only visual/geometric elements — no text. Elements ordered by Z-index (index 0 = bottommost layer).

elements.description: Ordered list of geometric elements. Index 0 is rendered first (bottom layer).

Color.description: CSS hex color (#RRGGBB or #RGB) or a standard LaTeX/xcolor name (e.g. black, white).

CoordX.description: Horizontal coordinate in cm. Top-left origin. X increases rightward (0=left, 21=right).

CoordY.description: Vertical coordinate in cm. Top-left origin. Y increases downward (0=top, 29.7=bottom).

BleedCoordX.description: Horizontal coordinate allowing bleed beyond A4 width (-5 to 26 cm). Shapes beyond the page boundary are clipped naturally. Use for shapes that bleed off the left/right edges.

BleedCoordY.description: Vertical coordinate allowing bleed beyond A4 height (-5 to 34.7 cm). Shapes beyond the page boundary are clipped naturally. Use for shapes that bleed off the top/bottom edges.

BackgroundElement.description: Full-page solid color fill. Must be the first element (index 0).

RectangleElement.description: Filled rectangle or rotated diamond/rhombus. Coordinates may extend beyond A4 for bleed/clipping effects. Use rotation:45 for diamond shapes. Shapes that bleed off-page are clipped by the page boundary.

x1.description: Left edge X of bounding box (cm, may be negative for bleed)

y1.description: Top edge Y of bounding box (cm) — smaller Y value

x2.description: Right edge X of bounding box (cm, may exceed 21 for bleed)

y2.description: Bottom edge Y of bounding box (cm) — larger Y value

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees around the bounding box center. 0 = axis-aligned, 45 = diamond. A large square rotated 45° and positioned near the page edge creates a triangular clip effect.

TriangleElement.description: Filled triangle defined by 3 vertices. Use for diagonal cuts, Swiss-style compositional splits, and triangular shapes. Vertices may extend beyond A4 for bleed effects.

CircleElement.description: Filled circle defined by center and radius. Center may be near or slightly beyond page edges for partial circles.

width.description: Stroke width in pt (e.g. 0.4 for hairline, 2.0 for bold)

PatternElement.description: Repeating geometric tiling rendered via foreach loops. Use instead of enumerating every instance individually.

x_start.description: X of first element: circle center or rect top-left (cm)

y_start.description: Y of first element: circle center or rect top-left (cm)

x_step.description: Horizontal distance between element origins (cm). Set less than 2×radius for overlapping circles.

y_step.description: Vertical distance between element origins (cm). Set less than 2×radius for overlapping circles.

colors.description: 1–4 colors. With 2 colors the default is checkerboard alternation.

color_rule.description: How colors cycle across cells: checker=mod(col+row,N), row=mod(row,N), col=mod(col,N).

stagger.description: Offset odd rows by x_step/2 rightward (fish-scale / hexagonal packing).

radius.description: Circle radius in cm — required for circle_grid.

width.description: Rectangle width in cm — required for rect_grid.

height.description: Rectangle height in cm — required for rect_grid.

rotation.description: Rotation of each rect around its center (degrees). 45 = diamond grid.
